title: Staff rota
summary: A shop open every day needs a different number of staff each day, and everyone works five days in a row. Find the fewest people who cover the week, and see why whole people need integer programming.
origin: Written for this project: the classic five-days-on, two-off pattern problem (the idea only, as in Winston's post office example; none of its numbers or wording), with its optimum proved by a counting bound and a rota that meets it (docs/research/spec-4-template-sources.md).
